Rate-limit error event inside a stream that already returned 200 and two chunks

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { createClient } from "@xberg-io/liter-llm";
async function main() {
  const client = createClient("your-api-key");
  try {
    const result = await client.chatStream({ messages: [{ content: "Hello", role: "user" }], model: "gpt-4", stream: true });
    for await (const resultChunk of result) {
      void resultChunk;
    }
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error) {
      console.error(`${error.name}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

void main();
```
